[![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MOdbs1vT8uDjG24zOJdXUsArM.png?width=280&height=280)\\
\\
LiveKit\\
\\
Run Pulse speech-to-text and Lightning text-to-speech inside the LiveKit Agents pipeline for real-time voice agents, with sub-70ms latency.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/livekit) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/io9QgkSvUHH5jLTQcVdtR5cclao.png?width=280&height=280)\\
\\
Pipecat\\
\\
Voice-enable your pipelines with Pulse speech-to-text and Lightning text-to-speech, streaming in real time at sub-70ms latency in production.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/pipecat) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/XHQrPMnwihr6kwAyvljnXBhg6n8.jpg?width=200&height=200)\\
\\
Agno\\
\\
Give your Agno agents a voice with Lightning text-to-speech. The SmallestTools toolkit adds speech as a tool any agent can call while reasoning.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/agno) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MOqFzRwBvfUkmUmeLpJ1rR5S5o.png?width=128&height=128)\\
\\
TEN Framework\\
\\
Set Smallest AI as the STT and TTS provider in TEN Framework. Because agents are declarative graphs, switching to Pulse and Lightning is config.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/ten-framework)

Agent platform

[![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Ldxehhvz9lAaiCuQf3W8B5lSh6A.png?width=225&height=225)\\
\\
Vapi\\
\\
Lightning text-to-speech is a built-in voice option in Vapi's assistant configuration. Pick it from the dropdown, no extra setup required.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/vapi) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/UeCoHErRiqBzkbeX6NUgMM28k.png?width=151&height=166)\\
\\
Dograh\\
\\
Set Smallest AI as the text-to-speech and speech-to-text provider in Dograh to build open-source voice agents on Lightning and Pulse.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/dograh) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/9FKh3oZfEtxLV5HZJ1I2ysJORs.png?width=512&height=512)\\
\\
Speko\\
\\
Use Pulse as the speech-to-text stage in Speko's voice agents. Pick it in the model setup and your agents finalize turns fast enough for real time.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/speko) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/30pNwKD3v8Tx3lQr3I7zVV1R08g.png?width=180&height=180)\\
\\
Rapida\\
\\
Set Smallest AI as the TTS and STT provider in Rapida, the voice AI orchestration platform. Pick a provider per capability, no code required.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/rapida) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/rEXL8CxvnGqtVR2OXBwDD6sLZJM.png?width=480&height=480)\\
\\
Bolna\\
\\
Connect Bolna to Smallest AI voice models to run Lightning text-to-speech and Pulse speech-to-text inside your Bolna phone agents.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/bolna) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aVgM86XeHKnvoPWlMDYpHI5iU.webp?width=200&height=200)\\
\\
Agora\\
\\
Set Smallest AI as the ASR and TTS provider in Agora's Conversational AI Engine. Vendors are declared in the agent's join config, so switching is a configuration change, not a code change.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/agora)

Smallest AI's verified community node brings speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice cloning APIs natively into your n8n workflows.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/n8n)

Zapier

\\
JellyPod Speech SDK\\
\\
Use Lightning text-to-speech in any JavaScript or TypeScript app. Stream audio from Node or the browser with just a few lines of code.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/jellypodsdk)

AI Gateway

[![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/IEnpAYVC7htaLDu2Xm3yh2cKTk.jpg?width=200&height=200)\\
\\
TrueFoundry AI Gateway\\
\\
Route Lightning text-to-speech and Pulse speech-to-text through TrueFoundry's AI gateway for unified access, logging, and cost control.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/truefoundry)

Telephony

[![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/9hKe0tJYNcUBgcV30IsBX4Wd4hM.png?width=600&height=600)\\
\\
Vonage\\
\\
Stream Lightning text-to-speech into live Vonage voice calls for real-time voice agents, IVR prompts, and outbound calling at scale.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/vonage) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/mstyZax28WAFYULLYirTCiZhU.png?width=446&height=448)\\
\\
Plivo\\
\\
Stream Lightning text-to-speech into live Plivo phone calls for real-time voice agents, IVR prompts, and outbound campaigns at scale.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/plivo) [![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/8X0E1gZ4LEhK4ezICxwOBgYPQ4E.png?width=2000&height=2000)\\
\\
SignalWire\\
\\
Use Lightning text-to-speech as a built-in voice in SignalWire's SWML AI agents. Pick a Smallest AI voice right in your script, with no bridging server to run.](https://smallest.ai/integrations/signalwire)
